title.value: An Intentional Forgetting-Driven Self-Healing Method For Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems
title.justification: The title reflects the focus of the study, which is the development of a self-healing method for Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) systems that uses intentional forgetting.
title.quote: In this paper, we propose Dr. DRL, an effective self-healing approach for DRL systems that integrates a novel mechanism of intentional forgetting into vanilla CL (i.e., standard CL) to overcome its main issues.

extractions.description: The paper discusses a self-healing method for Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) systems called Dr. DRL, which integrates intentional forgetting to address inefficiencies in Continual Learning (CL) when adapting to environmental drifts in production settings. This method prioritizes key problem-solving skills and accelerates adaptation in drifted environments.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on adapting DRL systems to changing environments. Adaptation is a core theme in adapting to climate change, particularly as it involves adjusting systems to cope with environmental changes effectively and efficiently.
primary_category.quote: Dr. DRL enables the adaptation of DRL agent’s behaviors at dual speeds, i.e., untouched major behavior neurons maintain larger updates compared to under-scaled minor behavior neurons. In order to evaluate our proposed improvement, we conduct self-healing experiments of different DRL agents on drifted environments...

secondary_categories.justification: The paper primarily focuses on adaptation strategies for AI systems rather than direct applications in environmental or ecological contexts. Therefore, it doesn't fit neatly into other eco-responsible categories beyond adaptation frameworks.
secondary_categories.quote: An Intentional Forgetting-Driven Self-Healing Method For Deep Reinforcement Learning Systems... focuses on self-healing mechanisms for AI systems without specific applications tied to eco-responsibility.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper relates to modeling and adapting AI systems for unpredictable and changing environmental conditions, akin to how climate risks modeling involves preparing for and mitigating unpredictable climatic changes.
primary_sub_category.quote: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is increasingly applied in large-scale productions... However, successive shifts of considerable magnitude may cause the production environment to drift from its original state.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The focus on intentional forgetting and self-healing in AI systems doesn't specifically align with other eco-responsible sub-categories since the applications are more about system processes than external environmental applications.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Our proposed approach, Dr. DRL, is in line with these current efforts, and by increasing the healing success ratio... it represents a step further in assuring the DRL system’s self-healing ability in response to environmental drifts often encountered in production settings.

applications.value: Adaptation of AI systems to dynamically changing production environments
applications.justification: The primary application discussed is the enhancement of DRL systems to adapt to significant environmental shifts, allowing them to function effectively in dynamically changing production environments.
applications.quote: Dr. DRL is able to maintain and, in some cases, to increase the average reward of CL by up to 45%, showing its effectiveness in dynamically adjusting the AI systems to changing environments.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper already fits into the existing category of Climate Change Adaptation due to its focus on system adaptation within AI.
new_primary_category.quote: The adaptation capabilities of Dr. DRL align with themes of Climate Change Adaptation as it deals with adjusting systems to cope with environmental changes effectively and efficiently.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: Climate Risks Modeling already encompasses the adaptation focus of the paper, especially as it involves adjusting AI models to cope with environmental changes.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The paper’s focus on self-healing for DRL systems due to environmental drift fits within Climate Risks Modeling as it mimics the process of adjusting to unpredictable environmental shifts.
